allow: PowerShell($p = Start-Process npx -ArgumentList "vite","--port","5199" -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput "$env:TEMP\\vitedev.log" -RedirectStandardError "$env:TEMP\\vitedeverr.log" -NoNewWindow; Start-Sleep -Seconds 6; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest "http://localhost:5199/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { "REQ ERR: $_" }; Get-Content "$env:TEMP\\vitedeverr.log" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -Last 15; Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force)
